statistic: Posterior mean of the group share formed on each accepted draw, at the 4-quarter-ahead forecast-error variance, as a share of TOTAL variance. This is what the paper's Figure 4 plots ('the mean of the sum of the decomposition') and what its ~40% / ~50% refer to; the identified shocks leave roughly 20% unexplained, so the shares are not renormalised.

fast_config.note: A noisy estimator: across sampling seeds the global GDP share has a standard deviation of about 6.5pp at this draw count. Distance from the production run is Monte Carlo, not a systematic disagreement.
